name: Code for Science & Society
summary: US charity that takes in public-interest technology, data and research projects as part of itself, with an advisory committee for each.

evidence.quote: What does CS&S look for in prospective projects? Mission Alignment. Our mission is to "advance the power of data to improve the social and economic lives of all people through public education, scientific research, and technology development and deployment."

gate.value: An advisory committee of at least 3, mostly people the project doesn’t pay

evidence.quote: Projects must have an advisory committee consisting of at least 3 people. The project's advisory committee will sign CS&S' fiscal sponsorship agreement. This committee's role is oversight. As such, the majority of the people on the committee must be independent advisors who are not paid by the project.
In this model, a project becomes a part of CS&S
our fiscal sponsorship fee is 15% of all cash that the project receives
